title: Read authentication configuration
responsibility: Validate supplied authentication settings and disable unavailable integrations without fallback credentials.

inputs.name: authConfig.env
inputs.description: Environment settings for Google sign-in, session secret, public origin, deployment environment and optional GitHub App.

outputs.name: authConfig
outputs.description: Configuration when client ID is valid, secret has at least 32 characters and environment is local, staging or production; otherwise null. Origin must be HTTPS, or loopback HTTP in local mode, without credentials, path, query or fragment. GitHub and collaboration settings are independently nullable.
